+    def filter_members(obj: Any, imported: bool = True) -> List[str]:
+        """Filter members based on imported_members setting.
+        
+        Returns a list of member names, excluding imported members if imported=False.
+        """
+        items = []  # type: List[str]
+        for name in dir(obj):
+            try:
+                value = safe_getattr(obj, name)
+            except AttributeError:
+                continue
+            # For modules, check if the member is defined in the module itself
+            if doc.objtype == 'module':
+                # Skip imported modules
+                if inspect.ismodule(value):
+                    if not imported:
+                        continue
+                # For non-modules, check __module__ attribute
+                elif not imported and getattr(value, '__module__', None) != obj.__name__:
+                    continue
+            # For classes, check if the member is defined in the class itself
+            elif doc.objtype == 'class':
+                # Skip inherited members if not imported_members
+                if not imported and name not in obj.__dict__:
+                    continue
+            items.append(name)
+        return items
